## Usage

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter
2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter
2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter
2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter

5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter
2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter
2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter
2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns

5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter
2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter
2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter

5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more

1. **Start tracking** opens a standard layout (initiative, enemies, allies, dice); **Try a demo fight** loads a sample encounter

3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere

2. Add combatants via **+ Add** (manual), **+ Monster** (Open5e search) or the Party Manager — they join the initiative order right away
3. Type each initiative roll, hit **Sort**, then **Next** to step through turns
4. Tap a combatant row to expand it — HP, conditions, stats
5. Add, drag (by the header grip) and resize panels as you like; **+ Module** adds more
6. Everything saves automatically in your browser. **Encounters** lets you keep a list of encounters, export a backup and import it elsewhere
